"You think you have a say in the fate of this wretched world? You think your insignificant vote will make a difference? I'll tell you what it will make - a mockery of your existence. So you can pretend to have a voice, to pretend to be a part of something greater than yourself? No, you'll be nothing but a pawn, a mere plaything for the powers that be.
